controls.letterbox_square: all source RGB pixels on a centered square canvas
controls.shared_asymmetric_letterbox_square: the same edge placement in every view
controls.asymmetric_letterbox_square: a deterministic edge placement sampled independently per view

primary_metric: paired relative-rotation error delta from symmetric letterbox
interpretation: This registered control isolates camera-canvas placement without cropping source support. Degradation under independent edge placement supports a coordinate-placement mechanism; a non-result remains a negative boundary and does not invalidate the separate crop finding.
